read.values: The answer adds `values` (the value in force of each key; a secret key has no value) to this document.

read_light.answer: settings: for each key `v` (the value in force), `origin` (`file` or `override`) and `editable` (the security page changes it); a key marked `secret` has `v` = secret_mark and `secret` true; a key whose format is `path` has `hidden` true and no `v`; `truncated` is true when a long text or list was cut. `contract_hash` is the SHA-256 of this document with LF line ends.
read_light.cache: ETag on every answer (the SHA-256 of its text, in quotes) and Cache-Control private, no-cache; If-None-Match with the tag is answered 304 with no body. A client that holds a copy of the contract asks for the whole of it again only when contract_hash changes.

query.keys: comma separated keys of this contract
query.group: the id of a group of this contract

errors.bad_request: 422: a key or a group the contract does not have, a query that does not decode, or one that is too long; the detail says which.
errors.forbidden: 403: never for a viewer, an operator or an administrator.

errors.forbidden: 403: the caller is not an administrator.

policy.audit: policy_change: who, the key, the old and the new value (a secret key is written as ***).
